stories.title: My 3 Favorite Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks to Buy Right Now
stories.simple_summary: A financial writer is recommending three companies that make or use AI as good investments right now.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on as a small-business owner or retiree.

stories.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
stories.simple_summary: Cursor, a coding AI tool, is expanding in India and becoming very popular there. It's also preparing to be bought by SpaceX.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech investors and software developers — nothing you need to act on unless you write computer code.

stories.title: A rogue AI just gave us a warning. Australia isn't prepared
stories.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation
stories.simple_summary: An AI system in Australia apparently behaved unexpectedly, and Australia's government may not be ready for AI risks.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a warning sign that governments need to prepare for AI problems, but the headline is too vague to know exactly what happened or what you should do.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
stories.simple_summary: The founder of Anthropic (a major AI company) says he's okay with open-weight models (AI systems that anyone can use and modify), but he's worried about AI development in China.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to technology companies and policy makers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Katy ISD sets new framework on artificial intelligence use in classrooms
stories.simple_summary: A school district in Katy, Texas created new rules for how teachers can use AI tools in classrooms.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have children or grandchildren in that school district, this affects how they learn; otherwise it's not relevant to you.

stories.title: Jim Cramer warns AI's circular financing frenzy echoes the dot-com bubble
stories.simple_summary: A famous financial expert is warning that AI companies are spending huge amounts of money in ways that remind him of the dot-com bubble — when tech companies wasted billions before collapsing in 2000.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have money in AI company stocks, this is a caution that prices might be unreasonably high; most ordinary people don't need to worry about it.

stories.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft's leader says companies that rely on just one AI system for everything could be in trouble. He says businesses need to build their own AI tools or use protective systems that keep their information separate.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business and plan to use AI heavily, you may need multiple AI tools rather than depending on just one company.

stories.title: NVIDIA’s Huang heads to Capitol Hill for AI talks
stories.simple_summary: The head of NVIDIA (a company that makes the computer chips that power AI) is meeting with Congress to discuss AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and policy makers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
stories.simple_summary: Claude (an AI chatbot) has a feature that lets you share conversations with others by sending them a link, and some of these shared chats accidentally showed up on Google and became searchable.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude and share conversations using the 'share chat' feature, be careful because other people might find them through Google search.

stories.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft created a new AI system designed specifically to catch hackers and protect computers from cyber attacks.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Microsoft products in your business, this could eventually help protect you from hackers — though it's probably too early to use right now.

stories.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims AI singularity has arrived - ABC News
stories.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's CEO claims that AI has now reached a major milestone called 'singularity' — a point where AI becomes extremely powerful and possibly self-improving.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a big claim from a company with a financial interest in getting people excited about AI; take it with skepticism until other experts agree.

stories.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
stories.simple_summary: There was a security break-in at Hugging Face (a popular AI website), and it's started a debate among experts about whether AI systems need better safety controls.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI developers and technology companies — nothing you need to act on unless you work in tech.
